sources.recommend_reason_zh: Terence Tao博客的客座文章以“无穷多个素数在有人证明前已存在”为例，讨论AI时代数学应视为发现还是发明，以及数学家如何理解独立于个人的数学秩序。

en.reason: Infinitely many primes existed before anyone proved it, a fact Karthik C. S., Amit Sahai and Jie Xue use on Terence Tao’s blog to ask whether AI-era mathematics is discovery or invention and how mathematicians grasp impersonal order.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章以“喜欢做、擅长做、有人付费”的三圈Venn图剖析AI冲击：数学证明三圈皆受威胁，数学家或转向解释结果与教学，software engineering则看目标是否“make something work”。

en.reason: A Venn diagram of what you like, are good at, and get paid for frames AI's threat to mathematicians seeking never-before-proven results, pushing them toward explaining results and teaching, while software engineering hinges on making something work.
